04 · About

A journalist who knows how stories get made.

Tyler is a junior at Marist University studying Communications with a Journalism concentration, a member of the Marist Honors Program and an intern at GamingTrend. His work spans published reviews, reporting, broadcast writing, production and scripted storytelling.

At Marist Club Television, he writes for False Advertising. He also supports university classrooms and television and podcast studios through the Marist University Media Center.
